sql.sql: select json_object(?, "users"."id", ?, "users"."name", ?, "users"."bio", ?, json(case when "users"."active" is null then 'null' when "users"."active" then 'true' else 'false' end)) from "users" order by "users"."id"

select "posts"."id", "posts"."title", length("posts"."title"), json_object(?, "users"."id", ?, "users"."name", ?, "users"."bio", ?, json(case when "users"."active" is null then 'null' when "users"."active" then 'true' else 'false' end)) from "posts" inner join "users" on "posts"."author_id" = "users"."id" order by "posts"."id"
